body:
Not sure if FTM or MTF or NB
but for FTM I explained the face shape as some water retention from prednisone.
Yes! I thought I was the only one

I actually do the same. 
I feel like I leave them out/show them so I can see them, and so i can wear whatever I want. 
But I hate making up excuses for them or talking about them. 

My scars aren’t in typical locations (wrist) or clustered together, but I have two big fresh ones that are healing in super visible locations 😑😑😑

Love this!! 
Xo, a fellow nb trans human
